Chico Freeman was born in Chicago on July 17, 1949. His talents as a saxophonist, percussionist, keyboardist and producer have allowed him to find success in a wide variety of musical genres. Chico currently leads his own ensembles and can occasionally be heard performing alongside his father, saxophonist Von Freeman.
Chico was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City at the IAJE convention. I’m very pleased to have Chico Freeman with me today, who is a saxophonist and a multi-instrumentalist and in general doing what it takes to be in the music business. Is that a fair assumption?
Yeah. Doing a few things that are involved in the music, yeah.
